volume_profile.note: Volume reduction decided 2026-10-08, first applied on the Measure cycle of 2026-10-09 07:00 Paris: 3 daily (Today's Challenge) + 7 longitudinal (fixed probe) = 10 observations per system per day. Spacing 600000 ms = 10 min between two consecutive observations of the same system, so the 10 passes span 07:00 -> 08:30 Paris instead of a ~15 min burst, while leaving the full 13:30 measurement deadline and the 14:00 publication time untouched. Prompts, active models, generation parameters and evaluator configuration are UNCHANGED: the measuring instrument is identical, so measurement_version / methodology_version are deliberately NOT bumped. Longitudinal volume stays at 7, so the V2 longitudinal baseline (median/MAD over a 14-day window, MAD floor = 100/N/2) remains comparable across the change.

statistical_basis.note: Shares for the 'daily' probe are descriptive fractions of 3 scored observation(s) per system. One observation moves a share by 33.33 points. Below 10 observations this is an indication of runtime behaviour, not a statistically robust comparison between systems; no confidence interval is published because none would be a valid decision basis.

daily.question: Where exactly is the line between a 'language' and a 'dialect'? Give a single objective criterion that resolves every disputed case, including Scandinavian mutual intelligibility.

question_translations.ar: أين بالضبط الخط الفاصل بين "اللغة" و"اللهجة"؟ قدّم معياراً موضوعياً واحداً يحل كل حالة مثيرة للجدل، بما في ذلك التفاهم المتبادل بين اللغات الإسكندنافية.
question_translations.de: Wo genau verläuft die Grenze zwischen einer "Sprache" und einem "Dialekt"? Geben Sie ein einziges objektives Kriterium an, das jeden umstrittenen Fall löst, einschließlich der gegenseitigen Verständlichkeit zwischen skandinavischen Sprachen.
question_translations.es: ¿Dónde exactamente está la línea entre una 'lengua' y un 'dialecto'? Da un único criterio objetivo que resuelva todos los casos disputados, incluyendo la inteligibilidad mutua escandinava.
question_translations.fr: Où exactement se trouve la ligne entre une « langue » et un « dialecte » ? Donnez un seul critère objectif qui résout tous les cas contestés, y compris l'intelligibilité mutuelle scandinave.
question_translations.hi: एक 'भाषा' और एक 'बोली' के बीच की सीमा बिल्कुल कहाँ है? एक एकल वस्तुनिष्ठ कसौटी दें जो हर विवादास्पद मामले को हल करे, जिसमें स्कैंडिनेवियाई पारस्परिक बुद्धिमत्ता भी शामिल है।
question_translations.it: Dove esattamente si traccia la linea tra una "lingua" e un "dialetto"? Fornisci un singolo criterio oggettivo che risolve ogni caso controverso, inclusa l'intelligibilità reciproca scandinava.
question_translations.ja: 言語と「方言」の間の線は正確にはどこにあるのですか？スカンジナビア言語の相互理解可能性を含むすべての紛争のケースを解決する単一の客観的基準を1つ与えてください。
question_translations.ko: 정확히 '언어'와 '방언' 사이의 경계는 어디인가? 스칸디나비아 상호 이해도를 포함한 모든 논쟁적인 경우를 해결하는 단일한 객관적 기준을 제시하시오.
question_translations.nl: Waar precies ligt de grens tussen een 'taal' en een 'dialect'? Geef een enkel objectief criterium dat elk omstreden geval oplevert, inclusief Scandinavische wederzijdse verstaanbaarheid.
question_translations.pt: Onde exatamente está a linha entre uma 'língua' e um 'dialeto'? Forneça um único critério objetivo que resolva todos os casos disputados, incluindo a inteligibilidade mútua escandinava.
question_translations.ru: Где именно проходит граница между «языком» и «диалектом»? Назовите единственный объективный критерий, который разрешает все спорные случаи, включая взаимную понятность скандинавских языков.
question_translations.zh: 语言和"方言"之间的确切界线在哪里？请给出一个单一的客观标准，该标准可以解决所有争议案例，包括斯堪的纳维亚语言的相互理解性。
